images.prompt: Create a premium editorial industrial still-life photograph for one of four matching website cards. Landscape 3:2 composition. Quiet, credible engineering aesthetic. Pale cool-gray smooth workbench and seamless light gray background; soft natural window daylight from upper left, gentle accurate shadows, a 50mm lens at a 35-degree downward angle, realistic machined metal and matte polymer surfaces. Restrained colours: neutral silver and charcoal with one tiny cobalt-blue #3E5AF5 material detail. Main objects arranged as a clear compact group within the central 75 percent, generous empty margins safe for responsive cropping. Same camera, scale and lighting throughout the set. Sharp technically plausible product details. No logos, letters, digits, brand names, hands, people, buildings, interface overlays or advertising graphics. This is a conceptual illustration, not documentary photography of a real company's facility or products. Subject: OEM integration. One small open brushed-aluminium rectangular equipment assembly containing an unbranded compact controller, clearly routed cables with physically connected terminal blocks and two sensor connection ports. A matching lid sits beside it, showing how components fit into an equipment assembly. Keep only a few legible structural parts, no sci-fi complexity.
